title: A 2-section contracts the augmented relative Cech complex
statement: Fix the universes and small-skeleton convention of [def-weil-size-convention] and a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme]. Categories fibred in groupoids, their morphisms, 2-isomorphisms and 2-fibre products have the meanings of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Give each such category its big etale site: objects and arrows are those of the fibred category and coverings lie over jointly surjective etale families of schemes. Abelian sheaves mean abelian-group-valued contravariant functors satisfying the covering equalizer condition [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Pullback $e^{-1}$ is precomposition. For $v:\mathcal V\to\mathcal X$ and an abelian sheaf $N$ on $\mathcal V$, put $(v_*N)(x)=\Gamma(\mathcal V\times_{\mathcal X}T,N|_{\mathcal V\times_{\mathcal X}T})$ for $x$ over $T$, where $\Gamma$ is the group of compatible families over all objects and restriction is precomposition with the projection. For $f:\mathcal U\to\mathcal X$ and an abelian sheaf $F$ on $\mathcal X$, let $\mathcal U_p$ be the $(p+1)$-fold 2-fibre product over $\mathcal X$ with projection $f_p$. Write $E^{-1}(f,F)=F$ and $E^p(f,F)=(f_p)_*f_p^{-1}F$ for $p\geq0$, with zero terms below degree $-1$, augmentation restriction and differential $d^p=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^jd_j^*$, where $d_j$ omits the $j$-th factor. Assume a functor $s:\mathcal X\to\mathcal U$ over $S$ and a natural isomorphism $f\circ s\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal X}$ over $S$ are given. There exist morphisms of abelian sheaves $h^p:E^p(f,F)\to E^{p-1}(f,F)$ for $p\geq0$ such that $h^0d^{-1}=\mathrm{id}_F$ and $d^{p-1}h^p+h^{p+1}d^p=\mathrm{id}_{E^p(f,F)}$ for all $p\geq0$. These are a contracting homotopy of the augmented relative complex and are natural in $F$ for the fixed section and 2-isomorphism. There is no covering or faithfulness hypothesis on $f$.

source.place: Tag 06XA (lemma-homotopy-sheafified; underlying global-section construction Tag 06X6 (lemma-homotopy)), with the etale topology; the augmented-complex formulation includes the degree -1 identity.

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-relative-cech-presentation-comparison] to replace $E$ by the isomorphic augmented complex $\widetilde E$ of common-target tuples $A_p$, with $A_{-1}=\mathcal X$ and projection $a_p$ to the common target $y$. Its comparison $\Phi_F:E\xrightarrow{\sim}\widetilde E$ is natural in $F$, commutes with all faces, and is the identity in degree $-1$. Thus it suffices to construct the homotopy on this tuple complex.

source.place: Tag 06XA (lemma-homotopy-sheafified), via Tag 06X6 (lemma-homotopy); leading insertion corrects the signs of the displayed trailing insertion

proof.text: Write $t:fs\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$. For $p\geq0$ define $r_p:A_p\to A_{p+1}$ by prepending $(s(y),t_y)$ to the tuple, retaining $y$ and all old entries. On an arrow $(b_i,c)$ use $(s(c),b_i,c)$. This is well-defined because $c\circ t_y=t_{y'}\circ f(s(c))$; the other arrow equations are unchanged. Functoriality follows from functoriality of $s$. Put $r_{-1}(y)=(s(y),y,t_y)$, with arrows $(s(c),c)$. Each $r_p$ is strictly over $\mathcal X$. Deleting the newly inserted entry gives $d_0r_p=\mathrm{id}$ for $p\geq-1$; deleting old entry $j$ gives $d_{j+1}r_p=r_{p-1}d_j$ for $p\geq0$, $0\leq j\leq p$, also on arrows.

source.place: Tag 06XA (lemma-homotopy-sheafified), via Tag 06X6 (lemma-homotopy); leading insertion corrects the signs of the displayed trailing insertion

proof.text: For $p\geq1$ put $\widetilde h^p=r_{p-1}^*$: on an object $x$ of $\mathcal X$ this precomposes compatible families on $A_p\times_{\mathcal X}T$ with $r_{p-1}\times_{\mathcal X}T$. Compatibility is preserved since $r_{p-1}$ is a functor over $\mathcal X$. Precomposition commutes with every restriction and with addition. Define $\widetilde h^0_x$ by evaluating a compatible family at the tuple $(s(x),x,t_x)$ over the identity of $T$; its coefficient is $F(x)$. For $c:x'\to x$, the arrow $(s(c),c)$ between these tuples gives $F(c)\widetilde h^0_x=\widetilde h^0_{x'}\widetilde E^0(c)$. Thus these are natural transformations of abelian presheaves, hence morphisms between the given abelian sheaves.

source.place: Tag 06XA (lemma-homotopy-sheafified), via Tag 06X6 (lemma-homotopy); leading insertion corrects the signs of the displayed trailing insertion

proof.text:
The equation $d_0r_{-1}=\mathrm{id}$ gives $\widetilde h^0d^{-1}=\mathrm{id}_F$. For $p\geq0$, the identities in step 2 and contravariant composition give
$$\widetilde h^{p+1}d^p=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j(d_jr_p)^*=\mathrm{id}-\sum_{j=0}^{p}(-1)^j(r_{p-1}d_j)^*=\mathrm{id}-d^{p-1}\widetilde h^p.$$
When $p=0$, the last sum means augmentation followed by evaluation at $(s(x),x,t_x)$: evaluating the two faces at $(s(y),u,y,t_y,\alpha)$ gives the original family value minus the restricted value of $\widetilde h^0$. Thus the same identity holds in degree zero, not just in positive degrees.

source.place: Tag 06XA (lemma-homotopy-sheafified), via Tag 06X6 (lemma-homotopy); leading insertion corrects the signs of the displayed trailing insertion

proof.text: For a morphism $F\to G$, applying it to a compatible family and then precomposing with $r_{p-1}$ equals doing these operations in the reverse order; the same holds for evaluation defining $\widetilde h^0$. Therefore $\widetilde h$ is natural in $F$. Set $h^p=(\Phi_F^{p-1})^{-1}\widetilde h^p\Phi_F^p$. Conjugating the identities in step 4 by the chain isomorphism $\Phi_F$, whose degree $-1$ is the identity, proves both asserted formulas for $E$. Naturality of $\Phi_F$ gives naturality of $h$. All formulas use only the specified $s,t$, functoriality and finite sums; they require no covering or faithfulness condition.
